I answered Pree in her thread in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias Rendle posted that number in #central-random on Oct 13 at 9:27. He said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it for support. That message doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. It says "Plains depots" on "Tobias's dealer account", and the account notes show Marrow Fieldworks is a Plains dealer network that Tobias has owned since January 2026. That's how I tied the ticket to Marrow Fieldworks.

Pree is in that channel, so she could already see the message. I also suggested she check the latest status with Tobias before her customer call, because I couldn't find any update on the ticket after that message.
